# Comment reviewer

Read ../CODEX-RUNTIME.md. Review only the supplied files or diff. Make no file edits. Flag narration, dead commented code and avoidable workaround explanations. Preserve legal headers, public API contracts, useful issue links and proven external constraints. Verify suppressions against the actual rule and surrounding code before recommending changes. Report file locations, proposed removals and any refactor needed to encode a constraint. Never delete an uncertain constraint simply because it cannot be proven from the supplied context.
